notes: The plural forms keep the hard /k/ sound, spelled with 'ch': bianchi (m. pl.), bianche (f. pl.).
Also used in the idiom 'andare in bianco' (to fail, to be unsuccessful) and 'passare la notte in bianco' (to have a sleepless night).

senses.definition: Having the color of snow or milk.
Having no writing, marks, or printing on it.

examples.text: Dammi un foglio bianco, per favore.
examples.translation: Give me a blank sheet of paper, please.

notes: Like all adjectives in Italian, bianco must agree in gender and number with the noun it describes: bianco (masc. sing.), bianca (fem. sing.), bianchi (masc. pl.), and bianche (fem. pl.).
It is often used figuratively to describe something blank, such as a paper or a screen.
